--- grant_queue_multiple.sql
GRANT SELECT, INSERT, DELETE ON QUEUE Q, OtherQueue TO ROLE producer, consumer

--- AST
&ast.Grant{
  Privilege: &ast.PrivilegeOnQueue{
    Privileges: []ast.TablePrivilege{
      &ast.SelectPrivilege{
        Select: 6,
        Rparen: -1,
      },
      &ast.InsertPrivilege{
        Insert: 14,
        Rparen: -1,
      },
      &ast.DeletePrivilege{
        Delete: 22,
      },
    },
    Names: []*ast.Path{
      &ast.Path{
        Idents: []*ast.Ident{
          &ast.Ident{
            NamePos: 38,
            NameEnd: 39,
            Name:    "Q",
          },
        },
      },
      &ast.Path{
        Idents: []*ast.Ident{
          &ast.Ident{
            NamePos: 41,
            NameEnd: 51,
            Name:    "OtherQueue",
          },
        },
      },
    },
  },
  Roles: []*ast.Ident{
    &ast.Ident{
      NamePos: 60,
      NameEnd: 68,
      Name:    "producer",
    },
    &ast.Ident{
      NamePos: 70,
      NameEnd: 78,
      Name:    "consumer",
    },
  },
}

--- SQL
GRANT SELECT, INSERT, DELETE ON QUEUE Q, OtherQueue TO ROLE producer, consumer
